SELECT
  g.id                        AS generator_id,
  g.name                      AS generator_name,
  g.status                    AS current_status,
  g.hours_since_last_service,
  g.maintenance_interval_hours,
  g.current_fuel_litres,
  g.tank_volume_litres,
  g.consumption_per_hour,
  g.accumulated_hours,
  l.id                        AS location_id,
  l.name                      AS location_name,
  l.company_id,
  -- Остання критична тривога щодо палива
  (SELECT MAX(created_at) FROM public.alerts WHERE generator_id = g.id AND type = 'fuel_critical') AS last_fuel_critical_alert,
  -- Остання тривога щодо низького рівня палива
  (SELECT MAX(created_at) FROM public.alerts WHERE generator_id = g.id AND type = 'fuel_low') AS last_fuel_low_alert,
  -- Остання заправка (income)
  (SELECT MAX(created_at) FROM public.fuel_logs WHERE generator_id = g.id AND type = 'income') AS last_refuel
FROM generators g
JOIN locations l ON l.id = g.location_id
WHERE g.id = '{{ $('When Executed by Another Workflow').item.json.generator_id }}';

SELECT
  u.telegram_id,
  u.full_name,
  m.role
FROM public.users u
JOIN public.user_company_memberships m ON u.id = m.user_id
WHERE m.company_id = '{{ $json.company_id }}'
  AND m.role IN ('owner', 'manager')
  AND u.telegram_id IS NOT NULL;

INSERT INTO alerts (company_id, generator_id, location_id, type, message)
VALUES (
  '{{ $json.company_id }}',
  '{{ $json.generator_id }}',
  '{{ $json.location_id }}',
  '{{ $json.type }}',
  '{{ $json.message.replace(/\'/g, "\'\'") }}'
)
ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;

UPDATE generators
SET status = '{{ $('Prepare messages').item.json.new_status }}'
WHERE id = '{{ $('Prepare messages').item.json.generator_id }}'
  AND '{{ $('Prepare messages').item.json.new_status }}' IS NOT NULL;
